newsitem.headline: Allstate Corp Q4 net up.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q4 operating earnings were $514 million, or $1.15 a share, compared with $379 million, or $0.85 a share, a year ago.
Full year operating earnings were $1.60 billion, or $3.57 a share, compared with $1.59 billion, or $3.53 a share in 1995.
Statutory premiums in life insurance business in the 1996 Q4 were $1.36 billion compared with $1.28 billion a year ago.
Property-liability revenue was $5.16 billion in the 1996 Q4 compared with $5.02 billion a year ago.
Personal lines written premium grew 5.3 percent to $4.50 billion in the 1996 Q4.
The 1996 Q4 combined ratio, including catastrophes, was 97.5 percent compared with 101.2 percent a year ago.
Excluding catastrophes, the Q4 combined ratio was 93.7 percent copmared with 96.2 percent a year ago.
